changes.title: Longer cloak scarf
items: Much longer cloaks and scarves in the creator: a cloak can stream far out behind you in flight and trail along the ground when you stand, and a scarf can fly out behind you, both rippling as you go

changes.title: Dropped hat
items: Knocked out, the witch drops her hat where she fell: a 🎩 pointer leads you back to it, and E on it puts it back on (a witch with no hat loses nothing)

changes.title: Party witch art first
items: Party witches show up straight away at home, instead of after the rest of the forest has been drawn
